description: Golden vectors for the setHash rollup (spec §5). Each vector gives a member map of locator → computedHash; rolling it up per §5 MUST produce exactly the recorded digest. Locators are hashed as given — no normalization applies to them.

vectors.name: empty-set
vectors.description: Zero members roll up to the SHA-256 of empty input.

vectors.name: two-members
vectors.description: Members are concatenated in UTF-8 byte order of the locator, regardless of map insertion order.

vectors.name: unicode-and-escaped-locators
vectors.description: Non-ASCII locators and characters JSON must escape sort by their UTF-8 bytes.
